tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect a remote Windows peer with an independent bridge process. official reads official settings without writing back; credential_ref can override its password. profile uses private credentials. Never pass passwords. Elevation requires an admin_credential_ref and local human approval before connecting.

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Close this server's terminal and connection. Reports whether terminal cleanup was confirmed.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read cached connection, identity, shell, cwd, policy and active command state. Does not insert a remote probe.

tools.name: exec_command
tools.description: Execute PowerShell in the persistent terminal. Stable operation_id deduplicates retries. Readonly accepts diagnostic:system_info/processes/services/network/disk/unicode with default cwd only. Free commands or custom cwd require enabled write policy and local approval. PTY output is combined; busy rejects concurrent commands.

tools.name: get_command_output
tools.description: Wait or page retained output by Unicode character offset. Waiting timeout leaves the command running. unknown means never automatically resubmit.

tools.name: cancel_command
tools.description: Cancel an approval or close the owned terminal. Confirmed terminal shutdown does not undo changes or guarantee that detached child processes stopped. Reconnect after terminal cancellation.

tools.name: get_system_info
tools.description: Run a fixed readonly probe for OS/build/architecture, PowerShell, identity/SID, administrator membership, cwd and existing tools. Returns busy if another command owns the terminal.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List this MCP instance's sessions and cached identities without connecting or probing.

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: Page persistent operation history, including earlier sessions. Output is queried with get_command_output.

tools.name: list_audit_events
tools.description: Page local audit events. Stored scripts/output may contain sensitive data; credentials are not recorded.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List one remote directory with metadata and bounded pagination. Reparse paths and configured root escapes are refused.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Read remote file/directory size, timestamps and attributes.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file up to 8 MiB. Unicode codepoint pagination, optional lines/tail, encoding/BOM/newline and SHA256. Use the returned next_offset and hash for stable follow-up reads; binary or unknown encoding is refused.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Approved text create/overwrite/append. Create is exclusive; existing files require expected_sha256. Locks during hash check/write, preserves encoding/BOM, retains a backup. Writes are not power-loss atomic. Larger/binary payloads use upload_file.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Approved exact replacement with hash and exclusive file lock. Default requires one match, preserves encoding/BOM/newlines and retains backup. No regex replacements.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Bounded filename wildcard search. Does not follow directory junctions/symlinks. Reports scanned/skipped counts and truncation.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Bounded content search, literal by default; regex has a per-match timeout. Returns paths, line numbers and capped text. Skips binary/inaccessible/large files and reparse directories.

tools.name: make_dir
tools.description: Approved directory creation. Existing paths and reparse components are refused.

tools.name: rename_file
tools.description: Approved file/directory move. Destination must not exist; no overwrite or recursive deletion.

tools.name: remove_file
tools.description: Approved file or empty-directory removal. Files require expected SHA256. Recursive deletion is not exposed.

tools.name: get_file_hash
tools.description: Read remote file SHA256 without uploading the file.

tools.name: get_file_signature
tools.description: Read Windows Authenticode status/publisher. A valid signature is not a malware verdict.

tools.name: list_processes
tools.description: Page processes with PID, creation time, parent, path, command line and unavailable fields.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Page service state, startup mode, account, executable and PID.

tools.name: list_installed_software
tools.description: Inventory HKLM 64/32 bit and current user's uninstall registry; portable software is not exhaustive.

tools.name: get_startup_items
tools.description: Inventory Run keys, startup folders, automatic services and scheduled tasks; report unavailable scopes.

tools.name: get_network_connections
tools.description: Page TCP/UDP endpoints and owning PIDs; querying does not modify networking.

tools.name: get_recent_events
tools.description: Read bounded recent events. Security logs may require elevation; messages are capped.

tools.name: get_security_status
tools.description: Read Defender availability, realtime protection, engine mode, signature and scan timestamps.

tools.name: kill_process
tools.description: Request human approval to terminate the exact PID and creation time. Protected processes are refused.

tools.name: control_service
tools.description: Request start/stop/restart with human approval and final state confirmation; critical services are refused.

tools.name: run_defender_scan
tools.description: Request a Defender scan. May quarantine files. Scan submission and confirmed scan completion are separate fields.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload one immutable captured local file using RustDesk's file channel, hash-verify staging, then commit. Human approval reviews source hash. Overwrite requires current remote SHA256 and retains a backup. No directory/automatic resume.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download one file to a new absolute local path after human approval. Verify local SHA256 against remote before/after hashes. Existing local destinations are refused; use a new path.

tools.name: list_runbooks
tools.description: List packaged PowerShell runbooks and full review text. These are templates, not automatic installation.

tools.name: exec_script
tools.description: Approve full UTF-8 .ps1 text and immutable SHA256, upload using the official file channel, execute with scalar typed parameters, retain artifacts. Choose local_path OR a listed runbook. Existing shell is default; shell_path explicitly invokes a separate PowerShell process. Use cleanup_artifacts for recorded files.

tools.name: download_url
tools.description: Opt-in trusted manifest download: HTTPS source, allowlisted redirects, fixed SHA256, bounded local staging, official upload and exclusive remote create. Arbitrary URLs/untrusted hashes are not accepted. Download progress can have unknown total.

tools.name: deploy_pwsh_portable
tools.description: Opt-in pinned official PowerShell ZIP deployment into a new owned directory, hash-check before bounded safe extraction and version probe. Windows x64 only. No MSI, PATH, registry changes or default shell switch; no unchecked cache reuse.

tools.name: cleanup_artifacts
tools.description: Approve deletion of this session's recorded artifacts only. Verify each file hash, reject reparse paths and remove directories only if empty. Changed/partial/unrecorded content remains with cleanup_pending; audit is retained.

tools.name: analyze_file_hash
tools.description: Optional VirusTotal hash-only lookup, enabled by local DPAPI API-key configuration. Sends no file content. Unknown/not-found/unavailable is not a clean verdict.
